related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

request.operation: link session activity that lacks service context to bounded, inspectable capability-call evidence

outcome.implementation_change: The existing ECI session-activity projection now groups bounded capability invocations that lack valid ambient owner-pass context. It retains capability identity, exact binding identity when available, invocation/completion counts, completion context and outcome summaries, nonzero return-code counts, and exact source-event references. Declared readiness probes expose the nested unclassified activity relation and exact current-binding match status. No agent attribution, manual-fallback label, missed-opportunity inference, or service-failure conclusion is generated.
outcome.verification_basis: Focused ECI and projection CLI tests pass; a bounded live query exposes three authentic unclassified calls with exact source references and reports a partial, truncated result.
outcome.analysis_limit: The projection makes activity and uncertainty inspectable. It does not yet record the scheduler decision or prove that any call fulfilled an eligible opportunity or reduced agent work.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Session evidence records ambient capability calls without the scheduler decisions that explain them
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose bounded scheduled and skipped owner-pass decisions with measured pass duration in the entry response and the existing session activity projection, without adding a write for a quiet run.

improvement_relation.basis: The targeted projection behavior is covered by regressions and is demonstrated against an authentic session containing three calls without recorded ambient owner-pass context. Exact bindings and source event references are available to another agent for investigation. This improves activity discoverability while leaving the decision trace and agent/service outcome unestablished.
not_measured: whether scheduler context is recorded for future capability invocations
whether calls are service initiated, agent requested, or otherwise triggered
whether calls correspond to eligible service opportunities or reduce intervention burden
whether the projection improves agent decisions across sessions
whether the pressure recurs across additional sessions
whether agents use the added activity references
whether the new projection reduces intervention work or changes service outcomes
